scene.ko: 공항 가는 택시가 다른 길로 가는 것 같아 정중하게 확인하고, 요금 · 내릴 곳 · 영수증을 정리한다.

lines.en: Excuse me, I don't mean to be rude, but isn't the airport the other way?
lines.ko: 실례지만, 기분 나쁘게 듣지 않으셨으면 하는데요, 공항은 반대쪽 아닌가요?
alt: Sorry, but I think the airport is in the other direction. Is that right?

lines.en: Ah, there's an accident on the highway, so I'm taking a detour.
lines.ko: 아, 고속도로에 사고가 나서 돌아가는 중이에요.

lines.en: I see. How much longer will it take this way? My flight leaves at 3.
lines.ko: 그렇군요. 이 길로 가면 얼마나 더 걸려요? 비행기가 3시에 떠나요.
alt: Oh, I see. How long will it take this way? My flight is at 3.

lines.en: Maybe twenty-five minutes. We should get there by 1:30.
That should be okay. Will the fare be much higher because of the detour?
lines.ko: 그럼 괜찮겠네요. 돌아가서 요금이 많이 더 나오나요?
alt: Okay. Will it cost a lot more because of the detour?

lines.en: A little, but I'll only charge you the normal fare.
That's very fair of you. Could you drop me off at Terminal 2, near Door 5?
lines.ko: 정말 공정하시네요. 2터미널 5번 문 근처에 내려 주실 수 있나요?
alt: That's very kind. Can you drop me off at Terminal 2, Door 5?

lines.en: No problem. Do you need a receipt?
Yes, please. I need it for my expense report.
alt: Yes, please. I need it for work.

expressions.en: I don't mean to be rude, but ___
expressions.note: 상대를 탓하는 것처럼 들리지 않게 물을 때
